answer: Declarations are reconciled in kernel, and as a result the operator census is checkable by anyone, and grove publishes it each epoch. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 6 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a vertex record. That is 29 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
